rule: Computed only from officially sourced numbers. Every value carries n and a 95% Fisher-z interval. n < 30 is not estimable for decisions.
settlement_note: Outcomes are the reconciled official final scores; 160/160 club checks match.

rows.label: Spread (home margin) x total points
rows.scope: 2026 played games, official final scores reconciled to standings

rows.label: Market win-probability imbalance x total points
rows.scope: 2026 played games with a stored community price; excluded from official-only gates

not_published.label: Injury designation -> team points (multi-week)
not_published.why: One official capture exists (2026-11-12). A correlation needs a dated series across weeks; with a single snapshot the designations cannot be aligned to the games they preceded without lookahead.

not_published.label: Depth-slot rank -> snap share
not_published.why: Depth ranks are official (30 clubs); snap counts are community-sourced. Publishing the correlation as an official one would relabel a community input.

not_published.label: Prop outcome -> game total
not_published.why: No official play-level prop outcome feed is held, and no licensed prop price series.

not_published.label: Leg A -> leg B inside a same-game parlay
not_published.why: Requires both a validated joint outcome series and the operator's settlement rules. Neither exists; see the blocked strategies S09/S10.
